name: Instant Shiyoujo
original_name: いんすたんとしようじょ
source:
Main character sees a strange flying in his post. It says that if you pour semen in a special container, the result will be an "Instant girl". No harm can come out of that, so why not try and see for yourself.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在他的帖子中看到了奇怪的飞行。据说，如果将精液倒入特殊容器中，结果将是“速成女孩”。这不会造成任何伤害，所以为什么不亲自尝试看看呢。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
